zone_description: A powerless deep-space freighter adrift in the black, silent except for the tick of cooling metal.
global_theme_rules: Every room is one compartment of the freighter Erebus: corridors, machine spaces, holds, crew decks. North/south/east/west run along a deck; up/down are ladderways and access shafts between decks, and the main reactor lies deep below the crew spaces. The ship is dead: cold, silence, drifting dust, emergency lighting at best. Keep base descriptions to permanent structure only — darkness, vacuum, depressurized or irradiated sections are obstacle entities, and prefer cleared_by_flag with flags like aux_power_restored or atmosphere_cycled so restoring one system opens whole sections at once. Technology is worn, industrial, and plausible; no aliens, no magic. Progress should trace a repair arc — find auxiliary power, restore life support, then restart the main reactor — and setting reactor_online wins the campaign.

starting_room.description: Rows of cryopods line the walls beneath a low ceiling of cable trays, their lids frosted from the inside. Your own pod stands open, still breathing pale vapor across the deck grating. By the forward hatch, a status panel glows on emergency battery.

entities.name: cryo bay status panel
entities.description: An amber screen scrolling a repeating fault log: MAIN REACTOR SCRAM — AUX POWER 11% AND FALLING — CREW REVIVAL: 1 OF 6 SUCCESSFUL. A deck schematic blinks helpfully at a route leading down.

starting_inventory.name: ship-issue multitool
starting_inventory.description: A folding multitool from the pod's survival pouch: driver heads, a short pry bar, wire snips, and a stubby flashlight good for a few hours.

win_message: The reactor's hum climbs from a shudder to a steady, rising thrum, and deck lights cascade on down every corridor at once. Vents cough, then breathe. The Erebus is alive again — and so, against every light on that status panel, are you. You've won.
